title: Degree conditions for $k$-strong orientations of digraphs
summary: Jackson and Thomassen conjectured that every $2k$-strong digraph contains a spanning $k$-strong oriented subdigraph. We prove sharp degree conditions for the existence of such a subdigraph. For every fixed positive integer $k$ and all sufficiently large $n$, every $n$-vertex digraph $D$ with $δ^0(D)\ge\lfloor(n+k-1)/2\rfloor$ admits a $k$-strong orientation. This threshold is best possible even for the weaker conclusion that $D$ itself is $k$-strong.
